name: vishwakarma
description: Two skills. Vishwakarma: design intelligence and engineering discipline for interfaces — computed colour, derived motion timing, platform-correct constants for web, Android and Apple, accessibility evidence grading, and a working discipline that resolves ambiguity, measures baselines and keeps diffs scoped. Vishwakarma Studios: game development intelligence — engines, the fixed timestep, physics, game feel, netcode, game AI, performance and shipping. Ships verification scripts.

author.name: Yogvid Wankhede and the Vishwakarma project authors
